tier: A (fully-scriptable — the boundary marker for the class)
essence: Warps the layer image through a single cubic-bezier patch: 4 draggable corner vertices + 8 edge-tangent handles define four curved edges, and the source is warped to fill that patch. Topology is FIXED — one quad, 4 vertices + 8 tangents, no Rows/Columns grid (this is what distinguishes it from ADBE MESH WARP). Used for banners/arcs, flag & cloth waves, page-edge curls, perspective corner-pulls, and conforming a flat texture onto a curved surface.
when_to_use: conform a flat texture to a curved surface
warp a title into a shape

state_model.reasoning: customValue = 0. Every load-bearing degree of freedom is an enumerated, named, animatable 2D_SPATIAL leaf: the 4 corners (ADBE BEZMESH-0001 top-left / -0004 top-right / -0007 bottom-right / -0010 bottom-left) + the 8 edge tangents (-0002/-0003/-0005/-0006/-0008/-0009/-0011/-0012), all expr:true. Render/blend scalars (Quality -0014, Effect Opacity, GPU) are plain params too. There is NO opaque core — the whole warp geometry is scriptable point-by-point. This card exists to mark the fully-scriptable END of the spatial/ML axis: the new capability-boundary fields nearly collapse here.

opaque_core: NONE (structurally — no plugin-internal blob, no linked file, no hidden/variable topology). The only thing outside the scriptable surface is not hidden STATE but a PERCEPTUAL JUDGMENT: deciding WHERE the 12 points must land to match specific image content or moving footage the product can't see.

scriptable_surface.controls: The full bezier control mesh — the ENTIRE load-bearing warp geometry, readable and writable point-by-point
Keyframe + expression channel on every one of the 12 mesh points (all expr:true)
scriptable_surface.example_params: wiggle() flutter on edge tangents (flag), sine breathing, link corners to tracker nulls/sliders
Quality ADBE BEZMESH-0014 (1-10 subdivision), Effect Opacity (0-100%), GPU Rendering

product_can.cap: Read back the exact warp: reconstruct the full mesh from the 4 vertices + 8 tangents
Author ANY parametric warp from scratch with ZERO handoff — bulge, pinch, arc/banner, single-corner perspective pull, page curl — by setting the 12 points
Keyframe + retime the warp (create/scale/offset/ease keys on any point) and rig expressions (wiggle flutter, sine breathing, null/slider drivers)
Interpolate between two saved warp POSES (essence-card presets) and blend them with a single slider

product_must_defer.task: Conform the mesh to specific IMAGE CONTENT the product cannot perceive (match a texture to a curved surface in the frame)
product_must_defer.user_action_asked: In the comp viewport, drag the 4 corner vertices + 8 tangent handles until the warp visually matches the target surface, and set at least one keyframe if it moves.
product_must_defer.then_product_can: Read those user-set poses straight back out of params -0001..-0012 and automate everything downstream (retime, ease, rig, blend to other poses). NOTE: if the pipeline can read rendered pixels, the visual loop can close this WITHOUT a handoff — this deferral is soft, unlike an opaque-core one.

product_must_defer.task: Make the warp TRACK moving footage (a surface that translates/rotates over time)
product_must_defer.user_action_asked: Either set the warp pose by hand on keyframes at the moving surface's extremes, OR run a track (mocha / point / 3D tracker) on the surface.
product_must_defer.then_product_can: Parent/link the 12 mesh points to the tracked nulls, or interpolate between the hand-set keyframe poses.

perception_signal.identify: matchName 'ADBE BEZMESH'; customValue = 0; 12 named 2D_SPATIAL animatable leaves ADBE BEZMESH-0001..-0012; fixed topology.
perception_signal.state_present_when: ALWAYS — the mesh points exist as params from the moment the effect is applied (default = an identity quad matching the layer corners). There is no create-step to gate.
perception_signal.state_absent_when: n/a — Tier A has no opaque core to be absent.

state_gate.on_present: author/keyframe/rig the mesh directly; defer ONLY the perceptual-judgment of where points land to match unseen image content (soft — the visual loop can close it)

config_recipes.arc / banner (smile curve): raise the two TOP tangents' Y (or lower the two BOTTOM) so the top edge bows — corners fixed, tangents pull the mid-edge up
config_recipes.flag / cloth wave: wiggle() on the edge tangents' X/Y at ~1-2 Hz, small amplitude, phase-offset left→right for a travelling ripple
config_recipes.single-corner perspective pull: drag ONE corner vertex inward + adjust its two adjacent tangents; leave the opposite corner fixed
config_recipes.page curl (corner): pull one corner back + curl its tangents so that edge rolls

reasoning_hooks.edges kink at the tangents: the tangent handles are too short/misaligned — lengthen them along the intended curve direction
reasoning_hooks.want it to breathe/flutter: expression the tangents (wiggle/sine), not the corners — corners set the frame, tangents set the motion
reasoning_hooks.can't tell where to put the points: that's the perceptual-judgment deferral — either the user drags to match the frame, OR (if pixels are readable) the visual loop nudges the points toward the target

grounding: introspect card (cards/ADBE_BEZMESH.json — 17 params, 15 leaf, 14 animatable, customValue 0) + state-model analysis (spatial-ml-state-model workflow, 2026-07-19) + model prior. HIGH confidence — the whole state is enumerated params, read directly. Teaching value: the Tier-A contrast to Roto/Element — shows that the spatial/ML fields are only load-bearing once state_model ≠ in-params, and introduces the SOFT `perceptual-judgment` deferral (distinct from an opaque-state hard handoff).
